column1: # CHAPTERS CLOSED BEFORE THE BUILD-PROOF RULE EXISTED (11/08/2026)
# Check 8 in consistency.py demands that every ✅ chapter carry a BUILD PROOF -- a part count, a
# vfy_fit line, a collision check -- or an explicit "NO MODEL ARTEFACT -- <why>" line saying it has
# nothing to build. The rule was written the day E.1 was caught closed with no staircase in the
# These 24-minus-7 rows predate it. They are NOT declared correct. They are declared UNREVIEWED,
# out loud, on every single run of the guard. Each one needs someone to open its notes and decide:
#   - it has an artefact that simply is not cited -> cite it, delete the line here
#   - it is a dialog / settings / views chapter with nothing to build -> write the NO MODEL
#     ARTEFACT line in its notes, delete the line here
#   - it was closed on reading alone -> demote it to 🟡 and build it
# ⚠️ THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK. Adding a row to it to make the guard go green is the exact
# failure it was written to prevent. A new chapter that cannot clear check 8 is not finished.
